scope: Precise primary-source replacements for the three Antigravity-added incumbent profiles. Other evidence fields, including identity and endorsements, require separate review and should be preserved unless separately corrected.
applyInstructions: For each candidate: replace role, hometown and the entire issues object; remove prior evidence with field role, hometown or beginning issues.; append evidence listed here. Preserve all other candidate fields. Data ID for Manley is natalie-a-manley, not natalie-manley.

candidates.role: State representative for the 98th District since January 2013; certified public accountant and chair of the House Health Care Availability and Access Committee.

issues.budgetTaxes: Her June 2026 legislative statement supports state-budget investment in education, senior services, first responders and healthcare.
issues.healthcare: Supports allowing qualified speech-language pathologists to diagnose autism in children under three to improve access to care.
issues.publicServices: As a founder of the Illinois Legislative Neurodiversity Caucus, emphasizes access to services and support for neurodivergent residents and their families.
